title: Oatmeal Crumbly Irish Soda Bread Gratin
description: Nutty, crumbly, and nostalgic Irish dish featuring yeast and a warm, comforting oat topping. Perfect for a cozy breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine yeast, warm water, and a pinch of sugar. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes until frothy.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the melted butter and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round loaf. Place it on a cedar plank or a baking sheet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown.
While the bread is baking, mix the oat topping ingredients in a bowl.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Transfer the bread to a serving dish and top it with the oat mixture.
Bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the oat topping is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
